speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar
text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs in the last five years (a) how many Police reports have been made involving sexual harassment or insults of modesty (i) through the use of technology and (ii) which occurred at the workplace respectively; and (b) how many of such reports have been made by women and men respectively.

speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
text: Are there other incidents of sexual harassment that have been reported to the Police that are outside of the use of technology or beyond the workplace?

speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
text: And are there plans to strengthen section 509 of the Penal Code to include men as victims of insult of modesty?
